data.body: Ticket 6 (byzantine-spinelike-penguin, the final ticket) plan-review BLOCKed hard with 7 findings, all converging on ONE critical mechanism gap: findings.py's normalize_finding (called via finalize_findings/build_result downstream of shim.py's _to_common_finding) UNCONDITIONALLY re-stamps a missing severity to "info" -- so my plan to "just omit severity in shim.py" would be silently defeated: review_result findings would still always carry severity="info" (arguably reintroducing a version of the original misleading-label bug), and the schema relaxation would never actually be exercised in the real path. Also caught: decide.py stamps severity at a 5th site I missed (a hardcoded "severity":"none" on the no-verification/indeterminate return, not just the 4 sev-variable sites); and needs to confirm whether completion_verdict.schema.json truly shares common.schema.json's $defs/finding with review_result.schema.json (if so, relaxing the shared required list technically loosens both, though completion-verification's own producers always populate severity in practice regardless of the schema requirement). Dispatched research on normalize_finding's full caller set (to see if changing it to leave severity absent-when-absent, rather than backfilling "info", would break anything) before rewriting ticket 6 a second time.
